understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the '+' goal gem by navigating horizontally and using gravity-driven falls, while avoiding spikes.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, then gravity automatically carries the player until landing or encountering a hazard or goal. Gravity was DOWN in this episode, moving toward smaller y-values. CLICK removes a targeted breakable tile without moving the player, and UNDO can revert the previous action. Landing on spikes causes failure; safe tiles support the player, and reaching the goal wins.
